item.title: Fujita Memorial Garden: Hirosaki's Taisho Garden — Guide
item.description: The Fujita Memorial Garden in Hirosaki is a refined two-level garden from the Taisho era. An upper garden with a Western villa and a lower garden with a pond and waterfall frame distant views of Mt. Iwaki — a peaceful stop away from the castle crowds. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Hirosaki, Aomori Hours ~9:00–17:00 (seasonal) Admission Around ¥320 Time needed About 1 hour Best time Spring–autumn; fresh green & foliage What to See The elegant upper garden with a Taisho-era Western villa.
